notices.title: **CANCELED*** Erda City Council Meeting
notices.agenda_text:
**PUBLIC NOTICE - CITY COUNCIL MEETING CANCELED**

Due to the **Tornado Warning** and out of concern for the safety of our residents, staff, and City Council members, **today's City Council meeting has been canceled**.

The meeting will be **rescheduled for a future date**, which will be announced as soon as possible.

Please stay safe, remain weather-aware, and follow all emergency alerts and guidance from local authorities.

Thank you for your understanding.

**City of Erda**

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing on Request to Disconnect from Erda City
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
ERDA CITY
PROPOSED DISCONNECTION PETITION
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN as required by Utah Code Ann. §10-2-501 that the Erda City Council will hold a public hearing to consider a petition for the disconnection of certain real property (Parcel # 01-441-0-0001) from the corporate limits of Erda City.
The public hearing will be held on August 13, 2026, at 7:00 p.m., at the Erda City Offices/Fire Station, 2163 W. Erda Way, Erda, UT, 84074.
In the public hearing, any person may speak and submit documents regarding the disconnection proposal.
Written comments/documents may be submitted to:
Jennifer Poole, Erda City Recorder
jpoole@erda.gov
(435) 243-5577
A copy of the disconnection petition is available for public inspection during regular business hours at the Erda City Fire Station, 2163 W Erda Way, Erda, Utah 84074 and on the Erda City Website at erda.gov 
DATED this 20th day of July, 2026.
/s/ Jennifer Poole
Erda City Recorder

notices.title: Notice of Public Hearing on Budget Amendment for Fiscal Year 2025-2026
notices.agenda_text:
NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING
ERDA CITY - FISCAL YEAR 2025-2026 BUDGET AMENDMENT
Notice is hereby given that the Erda City Council will hold a public hearing to consider an amendment to the Fiscal Year 2025-2026 Budget.
Date: June 11, 2026
Time: 7:00PM
Location: Erda City Office: 2163 W Erda Way, Erda Ut,
The purpose of the hearing is to receive public comment regarding proposed amendments to the City's budget, including adjustments to revenues and expenditures within various funds.
All interested persons are invited to attend and provide comments. A copy of the proposed budget amendment is available for public inspection at Erda City Hall during regular business hours.
